Film 'Alpha' Receives U/A Certificate Amidst Fee Disclosures

Yash Raj Films' upcoming movie 'Alpha', part of its spy universe, is set to release soon. Ahead of its premiere, the film has received a U/A certificate from the censor board, with some scenes reportedly modified. Meanwhile, details about the actors' fees for the film have also emerged, with reports indicating significant remuneration for the lead cast.
